tools.name: list_events
tools.title: List festival events
tools.description: List public Silliman University Founders Day / Hibalag Festival events, optionally filtered by date (YYYY-MM-DD), category, or a text query.

date.description: Filter to a single date, format YYYY-MM-DD (August 2026).

category.description: Filter by category: Featured, Religious, Alumni, Cultural, or Parties.

query.description: Free-text search across title, venue, lead unit and description.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 50).

tools.name: get_event
tools.title: Get event details
tools.description: Get the full public details of one Hibalag Festival event by its id (from list_events) or by an exact/partial title match.

tools.name: list_event_dates
tools.title: List festival dates
tools.description: List every public festival date with how many events happen on it, plus the categories present that day.
